nodes.title: Methyl-Seq/MRE-Seq
nodes.scope: Illumina grouped explanatory schematic: genomic DNA is split into MspI and HpaII digest branches, library-prepared at the broad level stated by the catalogue, sequenced, aligned and interpreted as a methylation-site result. That paired graph is retained as a family-level depiction; exact applicability to Brunner Methyl-Seq is not protocol-verified from its supplied abstract. A distinct, explicitly text-supported Maunakea MRE-seq variant uses HpaII/AciI/Hin6I parallel digests pooled before library construction and reads out unmethylated restriction-site CpGs. The catalogue shorthand MSRE/MRE-Seq is not treated as a third independently defined implementation. This is an architecture, not a laboratory recipe.
